data.title: AI Coaching Agent: Auto-Adjusts for Recovery | TrainZilla
data.description: TrainZilla's AI agent reads sleep, HRV and check-ins, then adjusts plans within safe guardrails — with a plain-language reason for each change.
data.keywords: AI coaching agent, recovery tracking software for personal trainers, HRV guided training, AI workout plan generator, recovery-aware programming, AI personal trainer, training load monitoring

_rationale: Previous description was scoped to meal-swap/check-in adjustment only (last cycle's nutrition focus) and said nothing about recovery data, leaving this high-intent page keyword-thin for the current Recovery-aware programming cluster. Now targets 'recovery tracking software for personal trainers' and 'HRV guided training' while staying accurate to the real weekly-rewrite + guardrails + rationale mechanism.
